title: Room Reservations Penalty Reversal Standard: Recorded Reasons
content:
## Standard

A cancellation penalty or no-show charge on a Room Reservations reservation is reversed only for one of three recorded reasons, and each reversal names the single original charge it reverses.

- A reversal is posted only on a reservation whose status is cancelled or no-show.
- The original charge must be a cancellation penalty or a no-show charge recorded on the same reservation, as the reservation's charge records show.

## The three reasons

| Recorded reason | When it applies | Amount reversed |
|---|---|---|
| Duplicate reservation | The charged reservation duplicates another reservation of the same guest at the same hotel with the same arrival and departure dates, booked on the same booked date, and that other reservation was checked in | The whole charge |
| Deadline misapplied | A late cancellation penalty sits on a reservation whose recorded cancellation moment is not later than the effective cancellation deadline under the cancellation deadline conditions | The whole charge |
| Penalty basis misapplied | *No longer in force:* the former clause "this reason applies when the amount charged exceeds the amount the plan's penalty basis yields for the reservation; only the excess is reversed" is no longer in force and has been superseded by the current basis | — |

## Limits

- Each original charge is reversed at most once, and the amount reversed never exceeds the net penalty charged on the reservation, that is its cancellation penalties and no-show charges less the reversals already posted on it.
- Illness, travel disruption, weather, flight cancellations, bereavement and changes of plan are not reasons under this standard, and guest services does not waive or reduce a penalty for them.

## Points of judgement

- **Duplicate booking, neither reservation used.** The duplicate reason needs the other reservation to have been checked in; where it was not, the reason does not apply.
- **Penalty on a cancellation recorded exactly at the deadline minute.** A cancellation recorded at the deadline minute is timely, so a late cancellation penalty on it falls under deadline misapplied and is reversed whole.
- **Guest unwell and unable to travel.** Not a reason; no reversal under this standard.

superseded_clauses: penalty_basis_misapplied applies when the amount charged exceeds the amount the plan's penalty basis yields for the reservation; only the excess is reversed.
